ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Even oxhide would have to be pierced is Yaoshan's answer to a source-unnamed questioner who asks to imitate his scripture reading. Chan records preserve the impossible-thickness image as the decisive line of that public exchange and repeatedly raise it for later comment.
EvidenceBody: The Patriarchs’ Hall Anthology gives the full Yaoshan exchange and assigns the answer to Yaoshan Weiyan. Later sayings and case commentaries quote the same question and answer, then ask what was being read or what sort of eye could pass through.
